# interpolate_labels { #mofography.helper.interpolate_labels }

```python
helper.interpolate_labels(regions)
```

Create a scipy.interpolator.RegularGridInterpolator, using 'nearest' method for the region labels (or any 3D numpy grid) 
over a unit box ([0,1]) in all axes.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name    | Type        | Description                     | Default    |
|---------|-------------|---------------------------------|------------|
| regions | numpy.array | 3D numpy array of region labels | _required_ |

## Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type                                      | Description                                                                              |
|--------|-------------------------------------------|------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
|        | scipy.interpolate.RegularGridInterpolator | a scipy RegularGridInterpolator object that works on the fractional coordinates of atoms |
